audience: project managers and agencies that run client projects, tasks and time tracking in ProWorkflow

useCases.title: Review the open tasks of a project
useCases.text: List the projects, then list the items of one project filtered by status or assigned contact. Open an item to read its details.

useCases.title: Check the time logged on a project
useCases.text: List the time records of a project for a date range. Read the project phases for their progress and financial metrics.

useCases.title: Review client invoices and quotes
useCases.text: List the invoices of a company, filtered by status or dates, and open one to see its phases and line items. List the quotes too.

useCases.title: Create a task and log time on it
useCases.text: Create a task in a project, then log the time a contact spent on it. Both actions create records in ProWorkflow.

useCases.title: Update a task and mark it complete
useCases.text: Change a task's dates, priority or assignees. Mark the task complete when it is done; the API cannot reopen a completed task.
